subject: general
question: In January 2025, Libia Lobo Sardesai was honoured with the Padma Shri for her historical contributions. What role did she play in Indian history?

options.text: Leader in the anti-emergency protest movement
Leader in the Bhoodan land reform movement
Defence researcher in Post Independent India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa’s liberation movement activist**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Libia Lobo Sardesai was a prominent figure in the **Goa liberation movement**, which aimed to free Goa from Portuguese colonial rule.
 
• She played a significant role as a **freedom fighter**, contributing to the efforts that ultimately led to Goa's liberation on **19 December 1961**.
